jobs.title: Senior AWS Consultant
jobs.description:
Senior AWS Consultant – Remote     Bright Vision Technologies  is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.   This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.    Job Title:  Senior AWS Consultant  Location:  100% Remote (United States)  Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2  Salary Range:  $120,000–$170,000 Annually  Experience:  6+ years   Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.    Job Summary  We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate large-scale, secure, and highly available cloud platforms on Amazon Web Services. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role spanning architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security, observability, and continuous operational improvement of mission-critical production workloads. The successful candidate will bring strong working knowledge of the AWS service portfolio, deep DevOps fundamentals, and a pragmatic, cost-aware design mindset, and will partner with application, security, and SRE teams to deliver resilient, cloud-native solutions that scale with the business.   Required Qualifications  
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on AWS in production environments. 
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, and CloudFormation. 
 Production-grade experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. 
 Solid experience designing and operating Amazon EKS or ECS clusters at scale. 
 Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines across infrastructure and application workloads. 
 Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash, with familiarity in Go or PowerShell considered a plus. 
 Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, key management, and compliance requirements. 
 Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and alerting in cloud-native environments. 
 Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. 
  Preferred Qualifications  
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or DevOps Engineer – Professional certification. 
 Experience with multi-account AWS Organizations and centralized governance. 
 Familiarity with service mesh, eBPF-based observability, and zero-trust networking. 
 Exposure to FinOps practices and well-architected cost-optimization frameworks. 
 Experience operating regulated workloads (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, FedRAMP).

jobs.title: Senior Ruby Backend Engineer with affinity for observability (d/w/m)
jobs.description:
Hypofriend has helped thousands of customers navigate the difficult journey of buying a home. Our online platform helps customers from calculating their affordability to getting matched to relevant properties to calculating and processing the optimal mortgage. 
 As a Senior Backend Engineer with an affinity for observability, you would be supporting both a customer-facing and an advisor-facing product that run on Vue.js, GraphQL, and Ruby on Rails, powered by AWS. Our customer-facing products include complex calculators wrapped in a simple UI, with a powerful calculation engine that takes thousands of mortgage products and optimizes them for our customers. 
 Our advisor-facing products include a fully-fledged back-office that ensures customer interactions over email, chat, and telephone — as well as the processing and handling of mortgage applications and financial documents — are reliable, efficient, and secure. 
 You'll help ensure our calculation engines, back-office tools, and customer-facing platform become more resilient and secure as we grow. 
 Tasks 
 💪🏽 Individuals who like getting things done 
 💬 Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with backend engineers and product teams 
 🔍 Eagerness to understand the systems end-to-end, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on 
 🔧 Someone who is as comfortable writing infrastructure-as-code as they are debugging a production incident 
 📈 A pragmatic approach to reliability — building the right amount of resilience, focussing on the key building blocks and clean architecture 
  Our technology stack  
 ⚙️  Backend  
 
 Ruby 4.0 (Rails 8.1) 
 PostgreSQL 16 
 Serverless Ruby, Node.JS, Python 
 
 🖌️  Frontend  
 
 Vue.js 3 
 CSS3 (flex & friends) 
 
 👷🏽  Infrastructure  
 
 AWS: ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront 
 Terraform for infrastructure-as-code 
 CI/CD pipelines 
 
 🔍  Testing & Reliability  
 
 RSpec 
 Monitoring & alerting tooling 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Strong commercial experience with  Ruby  (min 4-5 years), ideally including  Ruby on Rails 7/8  
  RSpec  experience 
 Good grasp of  OO patterns  
  Sentry ,  GitHub  and  Datadog  are your best friends 
 Hands-on production experience with  Terraform  for infrastructure-as-code 
 Working knowledge of  AWS  (ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, VPC networking, IAM) 
 Experience building and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines  
 Solid understanding of  observability : monitoring, logging, and alerting 
 Experience with  containerization  (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes) 
 Comfort with  incident response : on-call rotations, postmortems, and root-cause analysis 
 Good grasp of  RDBMS  operations ( PostgreSQL 16+ ) — backups, performance tuning, failover 
 A security-first mindset: familiarity with secrets management, least-privilege access, and cloud security best practices 
 
  Nice to have  
 
 Experience with  serverless Ruby, Node.JS  architectures 
 Familiarity with  GitHub Actions  
 Experience defining and tracking  SLIs/SLOs/error budgets  
 Scripting/automation experience beyond Ruby (Bash, Python) 
 Prior experience in a regulated industry (fintech, proptech, or similar) 
 
 Benefits 
  What can Hypofriend offer you?  
 👪 A young, motivated, and interdisciplinary team with years of experience building successful digital products 
 🏠 Work up to 100% from home, with occasional meetings and off-sites near our Berlin Headquarters 
 💥 In addition to an attractive fixed salary, you get the exciting opportunity to improve the German mortgage industry and be at the forefront of new and innovative practices 
 📈 Stock options in a growing company 
 💰 An 1,500 annual euro Learning budget 
 💼 As a young and rapidly growing company you have an excellent career perspective 
 💻 Latest Macbook and equipment to work from home 
 🏃🏼‍♂️ Urban Sports Membership 
 📍 A unique 3-story office at Rosenthaler Platz 
 🏡 Full support to become a homeowner

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.  The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.   At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.  As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you'll build and evolve the data foundation that powers Choco's internal analytics, AI capabilities, and customer-facing data products. As we scale to serve increasingly demanding enterprise customers, our data platform needs to meet higher standards for reliability, freshness, quality, and compliance. You'll own critical parts of our ingestion, transformation, and data platform ecosystem-helping us move toward enterprise-grade SLAs while making it easier for teams across Choco to build trustworthy data products.   This isn't a role focused purely on pipelines. You'll own problems end-to-end, from understanding why they matter to designing, shipping, operating, and driving adoption of scalable solutions.    What you'll do     Design and build a scalable data platform, from ingestion frameworks to the data products consumers rely on.    Build and operate batch, streaming, and CDC pipelines across heterogeneous data sources.    Deepen data observability and establish SLA/SLO frameworks around reliability, freshness, quality, and downstream impact.    Implement PII masking, retention, and data contracts that make compliance and governance part of the platform by design.    Improve data modeling, warehouse/lakehouse standards, and developer productivity through reusable tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows.    Lead technical initiatives from architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation.    Make pragmatic engineering decisions balancing scalability, reliability, cost, and business priorities.    Help prepare Choco's data platform for the next stage of enterprise-scale growth.     What you bring     5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or similar roles, with ownership of production data systems in a SaaS, fast-paced environment.    Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using technologies such as Spark/Databricks, dbt, Airflow, SQL, and Python.    Experience with streaming/CDC, heterogeneous data ingestion, and modern lakehouse or warehouse architectures.    Hands-on experience with data quality, observability, governance, and infrastructure-as-code followed by strong system design and technical judgement, with a track record of owning complex problems from discovery through production.    Clear communication and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.    Experience with Kafka/Kinesis/Debezium or supporting ML/AI workloads in production is a plus.    What you get    Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.    Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.    Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.    In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work,  including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office). new_jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.  The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.   At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.  As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you'll build and evolve the data foundation that powers Choco's internal analytics, AI capabilities, and customer-facing data products. As we scale to serve increasingly demanding enterprise customers, our data platform needs to meet higher standards for reliability, freshness, quality, and compliance. You'll own critical parts of our ingestion, transformation, and data platform ecosystem-helping us move toward enterprise-grade SLAs while making it easier for teams across Choco to build trustworthy data products.   This isn't a role focused purely on pipelines. You'll own problems end-to-end, from understanding why they matter to designing, shipping, operating, and driving adoption of scalable solutions.    What you'll do     Design and build a scalable data platform, from ingestion frameworks to the data products consumers rely on.    Build and operate batch, streaming, and CDC pipelines across heterogeneous data sources.    Deepen data observability and establish SLA/SLO frameworks around reliability, freshness, quality, and downstream impact.    Implement PII masking, retention, and data contracts that make compliance and governance part of the platform by design.    Improve data modeling, warehouse/lakehouse standards, and developer productivity through reusable tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows.    Lead technical initiatives from architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation.    Make pragmatic engineering decisions balancing scalability, reliability, cost, and business priorities.    Help prepare Choco's data platform for the next stage of enterprise-scale growth.     What you bring     5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or similar roles, with ownership of production data systems in a SaaS, fast-paced environment.    Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using technologies such as Spark/Databricks, dbt, Airflow, SQL, and Python.    Experience with streaming/CDC, heterogeneous data ingestion, and modern lakehouse or warehouse architectures.    Hands-on experience with data quality, observability, governance, and infrastructure-as-code followed by strong system design and technical judgement, with a track record of owning complex problems from discovery through production.    Clear communication and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.    Experience with Kafka/Kinesis/Debezium or supporting ML/AI workloads in production is a plus.    What you get    Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.    Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.    Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.    In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work,  including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).
